project:
-- Keiro 0.19 / Kiroku Store 0.9.0.1 / Kioku 0.8 / Shibuya Core 0.10 /
-- pg-migrate 1.2 cohort (2026-09-26), matching Rei's upgrade. Kiroku 0.9 ships
-- migration 0012, which has no rolling-deploy path: every writer must be on this
-- cohort before 0012 runs against a persistent database. The timestamp is the
-- newest Hackage index entry observed during implementation (a later pin fails
-- with Cabal-7159); never use `HEAD` here.
index-state: 2026-09-26T18:09:31Z
packages:
  mori-types
  mori-schema-pin
  mori-core
  mori-cli
  mori-api

optional-packages:
  mori-core/src/keiro-dsl-conformance.workspace.*/*.cabal

with-compiler: ghc-9.12.4
test-show-details: direct
tests: True
-- pg-migrate's predecessor-history hashing requires crypton >= 1.1; keep the
-- TLS cohort on http-client-tls >= 0.4 so Cabal selects one compatible stack.
constraints:
  -- baikai-openai still selects servant-multipart-client < 0.13, whose random
  -- bound excludes the 1.3 series.
  crypton >= 1.1,
  http-client-tls >= 0.4,
  random < 1.3,

-- Allow newer base for packages not yet updated to GHC 9.12
allow-newer:
  -- kiroku-cli 0.2 uses only the unchanged tlsManagerSettings API. Its released
  -- <0.4 bound predates Mori's required http-client-tls 0.4 cohort.
  -- baikai-kit 0.3.0.0 still declares crypton ^>=1.0 while the migration
  -- ledger requires crypton 1.1; it uses only the hashing surface, whose API
  -- is unchanged across that boundary. Keep this package-qualified exception
  -- until a released Baikai Kit widens the bound. baikai, baikai-claude, and
  -- baikai-openai 0.7 all admit http-client-tls 0.4, so their former
  -- exceptions are retired.
  -- Kioku 0.8 declares bounds for Keiro 0.19 and ephemeral-pg 0.3, and
  -- shibuya-kiroku-adapter 0.5.1.5 admits Shibuya Core 0.10, so their former
  -- exceptions are retired.
  proto-lens:base,
  proto-lens:ghc-prim,
  proto-lens:deepseq,
  proto-lens-runtime:base,
  baikai-kit:crypton,
  hasql-effectful:effectful,
  hasql-effectful:effectful-core,
  claude:http-client-tls,
  haxl:time,
  kiroku-cli:http-client-tls,
